newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain trade slow to restart.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain trade slow to restart.

text.p: Trading on the UK physical grain market was slow to restart on Monday.
"We thought things had been bad during the two weeks over Christmas and New Year, but this is even worse," said one trader.
"Farmers don't like the current prices and won't sell," said another.

No business was reported on the fob market although there was a bid for Feb feed wheat at 98 stg with an offer at 98.50 stg while Apr/Jun had a buyer at 100 stg and a seller at 100.75 stg, but buyers and sellers were showing no sign of movement.
Delivered trade was confined mainly to feed wheat with 97 stg paid for Jan in Tilbury and south Wales while Jan/Mar was traded at 98 and 98.50 stg in the Essex/Suffolk area.
